newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel forces kill 5 Hizbollah fighters in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israel forces kill 5 Hizbollah fighters in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli commandos in helicopters backed by planes raided suspected pro-Iranian Hizbollah targets in southern Lebanon, triggering fierce clashes early on Monday, residents said.

Heavy fighting lasting about two hours erupted between Israeli forces and Hizbollah (Party of God) fighters at Kfour in Nabatiyeh outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone after the helicopters struck.
Security sources and residents said five Hizbollah guerrillas were later killed by three roadside bombs planted by the Israeli commandos.
In Beirut, a Hizbollah statement confirmed that five guerrillas were killed by roadside bombs after the clashes.
Security sources said five Lebanese civilians were wounded by the bombs.
Israeli forces often clash with Hizbollah fighters in southern Lebanon, but Israeli commandos are rarely used.
Residents said Hizbollah fighters closed the battle area, which remained tense hours after the clashes ended.
They said Lebanese army units fired machineguns at the Israeli planes.
In Jerusalem, an army statement said "a number of terrorists" were wounded while all of the Israeli troops returned home safely.
It said an army force acted north of the occupation zone in an area around Nabatiyeh where it encountered and fought "a terrorist group" before returning.
Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli forces and their local militia allies from the 15-km (nine-mile) border zone.
